name: Kasshoku Orient Bijo to Shujuu Seikou ~Mashou no Wagamama Sakusei Keiyaku~
original_name: 褐色オリエント美女と主従性交 ～魔性のワガママ搾精契約～
source:
One day, when Ryuji accidentally drops the pyramid-shaped ornament sent to him by his globe-trotting archeologist father, smoke billows out and the shapely, olive-skinned foreign goddess "Leila" appears!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，龙二不小心掉落了周游世界的考古学家父亲送给他的金字塔形装饰品，烟雾滚滚，橄榄色皮肤的外国女神“莱拉”出现了！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751480/]Steam[/url]]
